prompt: Change the inventory report title to "Stock Report".
Add a second bulk discount tier: orders of 50 or more units get 15% off; 10 to 49 units keep 10%.
Rename format_price to format_money across the codebase (definition, every import and caller, tests). Do not keep the old name.
Add a Remaining() float64 method to TokenBucket that returns the number of tokens currently available, after refilling for elapsed time, without consuming any.
Bug: after a long idle period a TokenBucket allows more events than its capacity. Tokens must never exceed Capacity. Fix it.
Support the modulo operator % with the same precedence as * and /. Modulo by zero must return CalcError::DivisionByZero.
Bug: ringbuf_push reports the buffer full one element too early; a ring buffer created with capacity N must hold exactly N items. Fix it.
accept: make -s test && cc -Wall -o th test_hidden.c ringbuf.c && ./th
